notes.title: Update 0.30.0
notes.notes:
What's Changed
Added a Save Slot System

You can now have multiple save slots enabling starting a new game without overwriting a previous one!

notes.title: Update 0.29.0
notes.notes:
What's Changed
Hide meshes that might occlude player from view

Updated skill widget art

Added healing potions

Player no longer regenerates health while in combat

Added a mini boss to tutorial area

Added a single main boss to end of dungeon boss room

Redesigned boss room

Added Rebirth Flame, similar to Dark Souls' bonfire

Updated enemy health

Replaced enemies in dungeon paths to keys

Adjusted enemy AI during combat

Turning off ray tracing now completely turns off ray tracing, not just for Lumen

Other fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update 0.28.0
notes.notes: Updated lighting to look more consistent with Lumen GI when it is off.

notes.title: Update 0.27.2
notes.notes: Small update that fixes a runtime error

notes.title: Update 0.27.1
notes.notes:
What's Changed

 More improvements to enemy AI in combat
 Improved shadow and lighting performance using mega lights
 Baked directional lighting in start/tutorial area to improve performance (this area will be completely replaced in an upcoming update)
 Fixed enemies targeting player when investigating thrown rock but not seeing player
 More optimization to enemies and dungeon
 Removed unequipping weapon except when sprinting
 Added more sound effects and music
 Fixed feet overlapping in running and walking animations
 Fixed player floating on ledges causing Death Flame to float in hole player falls in
 Set slow motion after enemy death to occur rarely, 10% chance
 Increased damage radius when attacking
 Added new doors to more easily identify when they are locked or are one way and to make navigating dungeon easier
 Improved damage and blood effects
 Fixed interaction widget becoming hidden unexpectedly
 Separated Sprint and Jump Inputs
 Improved door functionality

notes.title: Valor & Blade Demo Update: Improvements Underway!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, sorry for the lack of recent updates, I have been working longer hours and have had less time to work on development for Valor & Blade.

I have temporarily taken the demo offline because it just not in a state that I feel like will properly represent the quality I hope to achieve with the full game.

I am also working on completely rebuilding the enemy AI as it has a lot of issues with the current structure.

Once the demo is in a state I am satisfied with, I will put it back online.

Thanks to everyone who has played the demo already, and I hope to have it back up soon!
